bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yoUSD has three independently issued native ERC-4626 vault deployments on Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum. YO's gateway documentation says deposits and redemptions occur independently on each chain and shares received on one chain can only be redeemed there; no yoUSD bridge representation, peer, message receiver, validator/DVN, bridge mint/burn role, or bridge-specific admin was identified. The route risk is therefore native/single-chain, while local vault controls remain in Mint Authority.
